{NUMBERED_INSTANCES}

What is the most precise and concise title for the subject matter shared by these instances?

v4.prompt_template:

1. “polishing a gold necklace”
2. “polishing a yellow metal ring”

“Polishing gold jewelry” is too specific: yellow metal does not establish gold.
